messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: I'm assembling the changelog and release notes for the docs push planned for tomorrow. Scope: migration guides (embed streaming), SDK snippet refresh (py/js), redirect cleanup, and a short known-issues section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
liam: I'll take the SDK snippets. Running quick smoke tests against python and node examples now.
sam: I'll run a link sweep and add redirects for stale anchors. Spotted one broken embed in the embed migration guide yesterday.
caroline: For the known issues, propose we call out: (a) embeddings streaming flag still behind a feature flag; (b) legacy python client import present in an example; (c) Windows install note about path-length errors.
maya: good call. I'll add a "Known issues & workarounds" block under the whatsnew blurb and link to the Windows workaround.
liam: Snippet change for Python: replace `from redwood_api import Client` with `from redwood import RedwoodClient`. Minimal sample for the notes:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("Summarize the quarterly metrics")
print(resp.text)
```
liam: confirmed this works on SDK v0.9.7; I'll push a tiny PR that updates the snippet.
maya: assigning reviewers: @liam for snippets, @sam for links/redirects, @caroline for whatsnew + known-issues copy. I'll draft the changelog header and release blurb.
sam: Link sweep plan: run `yarn docs:linkcheck`, then manual audit for external redirects. Will open a follow-up PR with fixes.
docs-bot: deploy-canary started for docs site at 2026-03-25T14:20:00Z  URL: https://canary.docs.redwood.com  status: building
caroline: add rollback note: if canary shows broken code blocks, run `./scripts/rollback_docs_canary.sh` and ping eng-docs.
maya: For changelog bullets keep it concise: - Embed streaming migration guide - SDK snippet updates (py/js) - Redirect and link fixes - Known Windows installer/path note
liam: Tiny nit: add SDK compatibility line: "Client example updated for SDK v0.9.7+" beneath each sample.
sam: Found two stale anchors in the migration guide: `#embed-legacy` and `#kv-cache-note`. I'll include permanent redirects in the link PR.
maya: target timeline: merge PR today by 18:00 PST, canary deploy 19:00 PST, final publish after green canary + signoff.
caroline: Acceptance checks before publish: smoke tests for samples pass, linkcheck < 2 failures, whatsnew + known-issues copy reviewed.
liam: I'll run smoke tests post-PR. ETA ~30m.
sam: Link PR in draft; will move to review once snippets land.
docs-bot: canary build completed  checks: linkcheck=1 warning, build=ok, smoke-tests=partial (python samples failed due to old import).
maya: noted. Liam, can you re-run tests after your snippet PR merges?
liam: pushed import fix, re-running smoke tests now.
docs-bot: smoke-tests passed for python and js samples.
maya: looks good. I'll merge and kick off final publish in 15 minutes.
caroline: adding rollback command into the release notes for ops: `./scripts/rollback_docs_canary.sh` (copy-paste friendly).
maya: merged and starting publish. Will post the whatsnew link in #general once it's live.
sam: reminder: keep redirect rules for `old-embed-guide` -> new path for at least 2 weeks post-publish.
liam: approved from my side :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone  marking this thread done once public link posted. :shipit:
